messages:
Maria: Heads-up — I'm planning secret rotations for ~20 Vault-backed ExternalSecrets in prod tomorrow morning. Don't want a thundering herd hitting Vault or mass app restarts. Proposed: roll in batches of 5 with ~1m jitter between patches. Any concerns?

AJ: SG. Does our ExternalSecrets controller support per-resource refreshInterval? We could set a short refresh for the one we want to rotate then revert.

Sam: We run external-secrets v0.5 in prod — spec supports `refreshInterval` on a per-secret basis. Setting it lower will make the controller pull new values, but it still depends on the secret provider's rotation semantics. Also watch Vault rate limits.

Maria: Good to know. For Terraform plan, I was going to update the ExternalSecret resources with a `rotation_trigger` annotation and apply in a loop. Example patch I prototyped:
```bash
for s in secret-a secret-b secret-c secret-d secret-e; do
  kubectl annotate externalsecret $s rotation-trigger=$(date +%s) --overwrite
  sleep $((RANDOM % 60 + 30))
done
```

Kevin: I'd prefer not to run random sleeps in CI. Could we make a one-off k8s Job that runs the patches and handles batching? That keeps audit logs in cluster.

AJ: Agreed. A Job with a list and `sleep` between each is fine. Make sure the job service account has least privilege (patch externalsecret) and that it's run from a maintenance window.

Sam: Also consider using Terraform `null_resource` with local-exec + triggers for dev/staging, but for prod the k8s Job + PR review is better.

infra-bot: rotation-job-staging applied by kevin at 2025-03-14T10:12Z — 0 errors, 5 secrets patched in 3m.

Maria: Thanks all. I'll draft the Job manifest and a short runbook (what to watch: Vault 429s, controller errors, app restart counts). Will post PR and tag @Kevin for the Job review :thumbsup:

Kevin: cool, ping me when PR ready. Might add a `maxParallelism=1` option in the Job to be extra-safe.

AJ: Also add a k8s `PodDisruptionBudget` check? Not necessary for this but call it out in runbook.

Maria: noted — will include. Done for now.
